llm_response.reason: Finfx.ai displays at least ten major scam characteristics: unrealistic benefits, psychological pressure (limited time, FOMO language), lack of verified business identity, unconventional/untraceable payment methods (cryptocurrency, UPI), lack of legitimate contact options (no valid business phone), vague/refusable refund policy, recently registered and anonymized domain ownership, handling of finance products often related to scams (forex, commodities, crypto), unsubstantiated client testimonials, and 'signal trading' services for paid membership. The combination of these factors, especially anonymity and payment methods, points strongly to an investment scam.
